edits.original: Field crews still collect vouchers, make no mistake.
edits.reason: "Make no mistake" is a finality interjection tacked onto a claim that already carries its own emphatic work; it repeats emphasis without adding evidence.

edits.original: so the change significantly streamlines cell-wall composition analysis.
edits.replacement: so the change cuts the assay time from 40 minutes to 6 minutes.
edits.reason: "Significantly" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; the numbers (40 minutes to 6 minutes) already stated in the sentence are the evidence it was standing in for.

edits.original: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle, full stop.
edits.replacement: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle.
edits.reason: "Full stop" is a finality interjection tacked onto a claim that already carries the exclusivity marker "only"; the marker already did the emphatic work.

edits.original: dramatically increased food production, averting famines in many regions.
edits.replacement: increased food production, averting famines in many regions.
edits.reason: "Dramatically" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; no specific number is supplied, so the padding word is removed.

edits.original: so supplemental irrigation dramatically reduces yield loss in dry years.
edits.replacement: so supplemental irrigation cuts yield loss from 41 percent to 8 percent in dry years.
edits.reason: "Dramatically" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; the numbers (41 percent to 8 percent) already stated in the sentence are the evidence it was standing in for.
